autoAssign.title: Assign automatically
autoAssign.description: First replier: an unassigned chat goes to the first member of staff who replies. Round robin: a chat that comes to your staff (handed to a person, or any chat while AI replies are off) goes to the online member of its team who got one the longest ago. Least busy: to the online member of its team with the fewest open chats. Teams (below) take chats by the visitor's language or the page; without teams, every member of staff. Away, offline and full members get none.
